import ctypes
import os

# Load the shared libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_cdf_geometric_P(const unsigned int k, const double p);
gsl.gsl_cdf_geometric_P.argtypes = [ctypes.c_uint, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_geometric_P.restype = ctypes.c_double

def geometric_cdf(k, p):
    """
    Compute the cumulative distribution function (CDF) for a geometric distribution.

    Parameters:
    k (int): Number of trials
    p (float): Probability of success in each trial

    Returns:
    float: CDF value
    """
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_geometric_P(k, p)
